title: KCP invocation_cancel request (DESIGN.md §10.6, §11.6.1 cancel family, §15.2, §15.4)
description: Mutation (meta required; §11.2: every state-changing operation requires meta). Durable cooperative cancellation (§15.4); a completion racing with cancellation is resolved by the authoritative revision transition. Dual-surface operation: one schema pair serves both registry entries (byom G35 pattern; gap note KG14). Registry (developer_assistant_v1): surface external_client / authenticated creator or authorized principal (assurance: current login) | surface worker / current attempt (own exact child invocation under an explicit parent capability) (assurance: worker capability). Surface and actor kind are registry-enforced, not schema-expressible (gap note KG14 for dual-surface ops).

cancellation_scope.description: Requested cancellation scope (§11.6.1 cancel row names 'cancellation scope'); DESIGN.md pins no value space — child work follows its recorded cancellation policy (§15.4). Bounded token, no enum invented (gap note KG14).

attempt_id.description: Worker-surface binding: worker cancellation binds the parent attempt (§11.6.1) and every worker operation carries {attempt_id, fence_epoch} (§15.2). Required together with fence_epoch on the worker surface, forbidden on external_client — a (operation, surface) registry rule the shared schema cannot express (gap note KG14).

args.description: Cancellation of the exact current invocation revision (meta.expected_revision; §11.2). Inherited ceilings and cancellation-policy evaluation are server-side, never wire args (gap note KG14).

commandMeta.description: Command.meta (§11.2). Required on every mutation; idempotency keys are scoped by authenticated actor, operation, and realm; expected_revision drives optimistic concurrency (mismatch is stale-revision).

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

freeText.description: Bounded free text. §11.8 bounds free text again at admission; the 4096-scalar schema ceiling is the recorded extraction bound (ops README gap note KG8).

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

statusToken.description: Lifecycle status token. DESIGN.md §10.5 names these status fields without pinning a value space; the bounded lowercase token pins the shape without inventing an enum (gap note KG6).

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent header value; excluded from the idempotency request digest (§11.2).
